It is therefore likely that the “28 deaths” figure is either a mis‑report, a later update not yet archived, or a conflation with another regional accident. - **Uncertainty:** We have not exhaustively searched every external outlet; the Archive may be missing newer reports, and the “Relay” quarantine boundary could have filtered some messages. Executing this targeted Relay query will provide a definitive answer about whether a 28‑death toll was ever publicly reported.
